parsed.notes: The filing names the two financial covenants but gives no actual values or required levels. It says only that the Company was in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The 4.25x lease-adjusted consolidated leverage ratio is a pro forma condition for making restricted payments, not the maintenance covenant level, so it is excluded. The leverage-based pricing grid sets only the interest margin (currently 1.75%) and is also excluded.
